March7.description: Twin-Soul Agent architecture — two independent agents communicating via A2A protocol, with a self-healing mechanism for background agent processing.

RAG.description: RAG system for PDF documents: hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25), query enhancement, and intelligent reranking. Modular, multi-provider LLM/embedding support.

agents-skills.description: Custom skills, instructions, and prompt templates for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Kimi, etc.).

another-brain.description: Long-term memory your AI coding agents actually share. One brain, many agents — standalone embedded MCP server: SQLite + FTS5 + vector hybrid search, local ONNX embeddings, self-expiring diary. No server, container, or daemon.
